item.title: Europe’s fires are just the start
item.description:
"Explore the alarming rise of wildfires in Europe and beyond, and what they reveal about the climate crisis, in our thought-provoking podcast 'Europe's fires are just the start'." (155 characters, including spaces)
Alternatively, for a shorter description: "Wildfires in Europe: a symptom of a larger climate crisis. Tune in to our podcast 'Europe's fires are just the start'." (138 characters, including spaces)
